policies: Enumeration starts from provider-native catalogue endpoints and never from legacy set codes, known Snorlax rows, cards, units, or verdict stores.
A complete slice means every record returned by that bounded request was retained and accounted for; it never means the provider or Pokemon set universe is complete.
Every raw record enters exactly one bucket: mapped, new-candidate, ambiguous/needs-evidence, or positively-excluded.
Empty catalogues, pagination failures, blocked requests, parse failures and unparsed finish clauses are run errors or needs-evidence states, never negative evidence.
Raw identifiers, names, scripts, suffixes, source-native prose and date precision survive normalization; cross-locale equivalence requires an explicit later mapping.
Adapter output is staging input for #136 and cannot mutate confirmation, contradiction, physical-printing, set-edition or release-event verdicts.
Revision-pinned historical indexes may enumerate every positive language cell in their bounded table section; dash cells and unlisted product categories remain unknown.

gaps.reason: The retained official surface is four exact checklist documents, not an empty-start expansion or product index.
gaps.retryCondition: Activate only after a provider-native enumerable catalogue endpoint and its pagination boundary are retained.

gaps.track: official Japanese sets, decks, promos and products
gaps.reason: Known product paths are directly fetchable, but the capability graph does not yet retain an exhaustive empty-start index and older products may have no page.
gaps.retryCondition: Retain and challenge an official index or sitemap before adding an enumeration adapter.

gaps.track: official Japanese card-search derived set identifiers
gaps.reason: The card search has known omissions and is a card surface, so deriving a closed set catalogue from it would turn missing cards into missing sets.
gaps.retryCondition: Use it in #136 for positive card records; activate here only if a separate provider-native set list is exposed.

gaps.track: official TW, ID, TH and SEA-English sets/products
gaps.reason: The retained surface is recent card search with locale-varying historical depth, not a bounded historical product catalogue.
gaps.retryCondition: Retain locale-native product indexes and pagination rules without seeding known cards.

gaps.reason: No technically and legally reviewed official CN/KR enumerable product surface exists in the capability graph.
gaps.retryCondition: Add the provider surface, retention terms, known-positive fixture and boundary challenge before an adapter.

gaps.reason: Product enumeration currently requires category and group identifiers whose empty-start discovery path is not yet retained.
gaps.retryCondition: Retain the category-to-group enumeration chain and licence-compatible raw fixtures.

gaps.track: bounded specialist catalogues for historical gaps
gaps.reason: Current specialist capabilities are positive search/listing records, not reviewed empty-start set catalogues; other specialist failure states remain in the capability graph.
gaps.retryCondition: Add one bounded adapter per specialist only after its source-native index, terms, and pagination are retained.

gaps.track: market catalogue and locality disagreement capture
gaps.reason: The surface is rate-limited and a market listing locality must remain separate from printing locality; neither can be silently merged.
gaps.retryCondition: Resume with a rate-safe snapshot and explicit provider-claim disagreement model.

gaps.track: decks, promos, catch-up products and other non-expansions
gaps.reason: No active empty-start adapter reaches these categories; treating expansion-only results as complete would strand valid local products.
gaps.retryCondition: Add explicit product-category edges and challenge fixtures before marking any category slice complete.

gaps.track: historical promos, decks and other non-expansion products
gaps.reason: The activated revision is a bounded English-set language table; it does not enumerate promo series, deck-only cards or every historical product.
gaps.retryCondition: Add separately revision-pinned product-category indexes and account every row; never extend expansion coverage to promos or decks.
